curated-fs-kalam-gf-kanit: Tightly bundled, hand-drawn warmth from Kalam leads the way. Kanit is the plain sans underneath, staying out of the way in text that is meant to be skimmed briefly.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-ledger: Ledger, dignified and bookish, sits beneath Kalam's cozy handwriting, maybe on a maker brand story card. Ledger's real gift is a measured thick-thin shading that gives Kalam's loose hand some gravity, though it prefers brevity.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-palanquin-dark: Hand-drawn warmth, tightly bundled, up top, with Palanquin Dark, a clean sans-serif, below (maybe a bar mitzvah invitation). Kalam charms with personality, while Palanquin Dark keeps modest amounts of text tidy.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-playfair: Kalam has a hand-drawn, tightly bundled look that feels inviting. Playfair, a traditional serif with pale threads between heavy stems, gives text a dignified feel, though it is happiest running just a few lines.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-reddit-mono: Kalam's hand-drawn, tightly bundled lines look inviting. Reddit Mono, a monospace with code-style fixed-width letters, suits brief reading, while Kalam earns its keep big and short, as on a neighborhood association logo.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-stoke: Kalam's cozy handwriting would look right on a woodworking shop sign. Kalam delivers hand-drawn warmth, while Stoke, bookish and editorial, with watercolor-soft weight shifts and wide letter spacing, does its best work well short of a full paragraph.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-tiro-devanagari-sans: Friendly scrawl meets refined authority. Kalam's tightly bundled handwriting loosens things up, while Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit adds gravity with bold stems and wire-thin horizontals, though whole paragraphs aren't its job.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-tiro-kannada: Cozy and hand-drawn, with fine-threaded Tiro Kannada underneath, a pairing you might spot on a yoga studio logo. Kalam's warmth against swelling serif curves is the draw, pleasant in light helpings.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-vollkorn: Kalam's hand-drawn warmth suits, say, a sticker shop. Vollkorn, a text serif, grounds that handwriting with a steady yet faintly modulated line and slightly lighter horizontals, though it is not built for long paragraphs.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-zcool-kuaile: Inviting and cozy, Kalam writes in tightly bundled, hand-drawn lines that feel personal. ZCOOL KuaiLe supplies the wire-like monoline skeleton, an approachable foil that is happiest with brief snippets.
